cases.sentence: От них после потопа произошли все ___ на земле».
cases.translation: From them, after the flood, came all the nations on the earth.
cases.explain: Народы is the plural subject of произошли, so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Из той ___ он перешел в Асирию, где построил Ниневию.
cases.translation: From that land he crossed into Assyria, where he built Nineveh.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: От них произошли приморские народы и распространились по своим ___, среди своих народов, у каждого свой язык.
cases.translation: From them came the coastal nations, spreading out over their lands, among their nations, each with its own language.
cases.explain: The preposition по (over/along) governs the dative case (here, dative plural).

cases.sentence: Из той земли он перешел в Асирию, где построил Ниневию, Рихавод-Ир, Калах и Ресен, между Ниневией и Калахом, в Великий ___.
cases.translation: From that land he crossed into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah, and Resen, between Nineveh and Calah, the great city.
cases.explain: The preposition в with a verb of motion takes the accusative for direction into a place; for this inanimate noun the accusative matches the nominative form.

cases.sentence: Первыми ___ в его царстве были Вавилон, Эрех, Акат и Халны в Шинаре.
cases.translation: The first cities in his kingdom were Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in Shinar.
cases.explain: The instrumental plural городами is used as the predicate complement of были (were) — 'were [as] cities'.

cases.sentence: Первыми городами в его ___ были Вавилон, Эрех, Акат и Халны в Шинаре.
cases.translation: The first cities in his kingdom were Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in Shinar.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Сыновья Иофета — Гомер, Магок, Мадай, Иован, Тувал, Мешех и Терас.
reading.question: Who were listed as the sons of Japheth?
options: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras
Elam, Asshur, Arpahshad, Lud, and Aram
reading.correct: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras
reading.explain: The text lists Japheth's sons as 'Гомер, Магок, Мадай, Иован, Тувал, Мешех и Терас'.

reading.ru: Куш был отцом и Немрода, который стал первым на земле могучим воином.
reading.question: What was Nimrod known for?
options: He became the first mighty warrior on earth
He built the tower of Babel
He was the father of Canaan
He was the youngest son of Noah
reading.correct: He became the first mighty warrior on earth
reading.explain: The text says Nimrod 'стал первым на земле могучим воином' (became the first mighty warrior on earth).

reading.ru: Первыми городами в его царстве были Вавилон, Эрех, Акат и Халны в Шинаре.
reading.question: What were the first cities of Nimrod's kingdom?
options: Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in Shinar
Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah, and Resen
reading.correct: Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in Shinar
reading.explain: The text names 'Вавилон, Эрех, Акат и Халны в Шинаре' as the first cities of his kingdom.

reading.ru: Позже ханаанские племена рассеялись, и границы Ханаана простирались от Сидона к Герару до Газы, а оттуда к Содому, Гаморе, Адме и Цеваиму до Лаши.
reading.question: How far did the borders of Canaan extend?
options: From Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and on toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim as far as Lasha
reading.correct: From Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and on toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim as far as Lasha
reading.explain: The text traces the Canaanite border 'от Сидона к Герару до Газы... к Содому, Гаморе, Адме и Цеваиму до Лаши'.

reading.ru: Сим был предком всех сыновей Евера.
reading.question: Whose ancestor was Shem, according to the text?
reading.explain: The text says 'Сим был предком всех сыновей Евера' (Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber).

reading.ru: От них после потопа произошли все народы на земле».
reading.question: According to the chapter, where did all the nations of the earth come from?
options: From the sons of Noah after the flood
reading.correct: From the sons of Noah after the flood
reading.explain: The chapter concludes that 'от них после потопа произошли все народы на земле' (from them, after the flood, came all the nations of the earth).
